title: Isihlalo Sobukhosi Seqiniso
intro: Umbusi onamandla, owaziwa ngokuhlakanipha kwakhe okukhulu nesihlalo sakhe sobukhosi esimangalisayo, uthola umyalezo oyimfihlakalo ovela emthonjeni ongaziwa. Lokhu kuxhumana okungalindelekile kubeka inselele ezinkolelweni zabo negunya, kubabeka ohambweni lwezombusazwe oluzovivinya ubuhlakani babo futhi ekugcineni luholele ekuvukeni okujulile ngokomoya. Ungakwazi yini ukuthola ukuthi ungubani lo mbusi kanye nezenzakalo ezaguqula wonke umbuso wabo?
clues: Mina nabantu bami sasikhulekela ilanga, silandela izindlela zokhokho bethu.
Inyoni, i-hoopoe, yayiyisithunywa esingalindelekile esangilethela incwadi evela kumholi onamandla.
Ukuze ngivivinye ukuhlakanipha komthumeli, ngathumela izipho eziyigugu, kodwa zabuyiselwa, njengoba umthumeli wayenengcebo enkulu kakhulu evela ku-Allah.
Ngaphambi kokuba ngifike ngisho nasegcekeni lomthumeli, isihlalo sami sobukhosi esihle kakhulu sathuthwa ngokuyisimangaliso lapho ngokuphazima kweso.
Lapho ngifika, ngabuzwa ukuthi isihlalo sobukhosi esithuthiwe sasingesami yini, futhi ngaphendula ngathi, 'Kunjengokungathi yiso kanye.'
Ngangena ehholo elikhulu elalinephansi engangicabanga ukuthi liyichibi lamanzi, futhi ngaleso sikhathi sokumangala, ngazithoba kanye noMprofethi uSulaiman ku-Allah, iNkosi yezwe.

arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ٱدْخُلِى ٱلصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةًۭ وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ صَرْحٌۭ مُّمَرَّدٌۭ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verse: She was told, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins [to wade through]. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace [whose floor is] made smooth with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allāh, Lord of the worlds." (27:44)
